traits.name: Fog Vision
traits.text: The silver dragon ignores the concealed condition from fog and clouds.

traits.name: Cold Aura
traits.text: ⬲ (cold, aura); 15 feet, 3d6 (3d6) cold damage. The silver dragon can turn this aura on or off as a single action, which has the concentrate trait, and can choose not to affect allies within the aura. Reflect Spell Trigger The silver dragon critically succeeds at a saving throw against a spell, or a caster trying to target the dragon critically fails their attack roll. The spell is reflected back upon the caster, with the effect of spell turning.

traits.name: Wing Deflection
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The silver dragon is targeted with an attack. Effect The dragon raises its wing, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the dragon is flying, it descends 10 feet after the attack is complete.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text:
⬺ The silver dragon breathes in one of two ways. The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.
  • Frost (arcane, cold, evocation); The dragon breathes a cloud of frost in a 50-foot cone that deals 20d6 (20d6) cold damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save).
  • Paralyzing Gas (arcane, enchantment, incapacitation); The dragon breathes a blast of paralyzing gas. Each creature within a 50-foot cone must succeed at a DC 42 Fortitude save or be paralyzed for 1 round (or 3 rounds on a critical failure).

traits.name: Cloud Walk
traits.text: The silver dragon can tread on clouds or fog as though on solid ground.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The silver dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: When the silver dragon scores a critical hit with a Strike, it recharges its Breath Weapon.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +37 (cold, magical, reach 20 feet); Damage 4d10+17 (4d10+17) piercing plus 4d6 (4d6) cold

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +37 (agile, magical, reach 15 feet); Damage 4d8+17 (4d8+17) slashing
